_설명: 스프라이트 생성 설정. prompt는 자유롭게 고쳐도 된다. refs는 참고 폴더(art/reference/<이름>)이고, 고양이는 cats 폴더에 고양이 이름으로 된 파일(stray.png, cheese_1.png 등)이 있으면 그 그림을 맨 앞에 둔다.
style: Match the art style of the reference images exactly: cute chibi kawaii 2D game sprite, thick dark brown outline, soft flat pastel colors with simple cel shading and small white highlights, rounded friendly shapes. Draw exactly ONE subject, centered, fully inside the frame with a small margin. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no frame, no ground shadow, no background scenery: transparent background.

group_rules.char: Game character sprite, readable at small size.
group_rules.cat: Game enemy sprite: one cat only, full body, side view facing LEFT, walking pose, readable at small size. Do not copy any single cat from the reference exactly; follow its drawing style.
group_rules.pick: Small collectible pickup item for a game, readable at very small size, chunky shapes.
group_rules.icon: Square inventory icon, bold silhouette, readable at 30 pixels, no border or badge background.
group_rules.proj: Small game projectile or weapon effect, simple bold shape, readable at small size.
group_rules.fx: Game visual effect, made to be scaled up and laid over the ground, soft and translucent.
group_rules.walk: Second frame of a two-frame walking animation. The FIRST reference image is frame 1 of this exact sprite. Redraw the SAME character with an identical design, colors, outline thickness, proportions, size, framing and facing direction (exactly as in frame 1); keep the head and body in the same place. Change ONLY the legs (and the tail, if any) to the opposite step of the walk cycle: legs that were forward in frame 1 are now back.
group_rules.part: Tiny particle sprite for a game effect: exactly one small object, simple bold shape with the same thick dark brown outline, readable at 12 pixels, centered, nothing else.
